newsitem.title: USA: Central Illinois 900 MW unit seen back Friday.
newsitem.headline: Central Illinois 900 MW unit seen back Friday.

text.p: Central Illinois Power Service Co's 900 megawatt (MW) Coffeen coal-fired power generation plant was expected to resume production Friday after being shut earlier this week for repairs, a company spokesman said.
"Baring any unforeseen events we expect that unit to resume production later this afternoon," company spokesman Sam Poe said Friday.
The 340 MW Coffeen unit 1 was taken off line Tuesday night to repair a boiler tube leak, while the 560 MW Coffeen unit 2 was taken off line early Wednesday, also to repair a leak.
The Coffeen plant, owned and operated by Central Illinois Public Service, is about 50 miles southeast of Springfield, Ill.
